title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Badges that came back on their own, twice more
summary: Two more badge providers repainted what the user had just switched off, once their project sweep landed.

highlights.title: A setting that undid itself
highlights.description: Resource usage badges switched off while the sweep was running were drawn again when it landed, seconds later.

highlights.title: Painting through a provider that is gone
highlights.description: The manifest necessity badges had no disposal flag at all, so a late sweep wrote through a decoration type that no longer exists.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Resource usage badges stay off once switched off, even when a project sweep was already running.
Manifest necessity badges do the same, and no longer paint after the provider is disposed.
